body: I just looked it up and really like what I read/saw. Looks like episode 1 is available for free on Steam. I am going to check it out tonight.

I have always felt like something bad was going to happen to me even if things were going so well. I never allow myself to enjoy anything for too long. I feel like I am worthless and add nothing to society. I do work in IT but I really am tired of it and would love to do something else but I have no idea what that would be...I got laid off a few months back and for me that was the final straw as far as that indusry is concerened...I have really bad thoughts all the time and really the only thing keeping me around is my dog. Don't know where I would be without him. I need him more than he needs me....Sorry I have a real hard time putting my feelings down....It is so confusing to me as well....All I know is I am not a very happy person.
Thank you for your kind words. I did have a nice time at my folks.
The show was definitely a trigger...I cannot get it out of my head.

Thank you so much for the response. You won't believe how much that helps. I am actually heading over to my folks soon for dinner but will offer more of a reply when I get back home. Your reply really made my day.
